$comment: meteor-cfd - Copyright (c) 2026 주식회사 이터레이션즈 (Iterations Co., Ltd.). No GPL-licensed source was consulted. G-SCORER fixtures: the docs/15 survey probes. The 27 that wrote a summary were re-run on 2026-09-24 with the mesh tree's binary at 77a33b5 (sha256 054bba67...) so their summaries carry n_pinned_boundary, area_ratio and area_frac_tau_ge; the 4 refused runs keep their 2026-09-23 logs (refusal re-confirmed). Hand labels and expected numbers are the supervisor's, computed from the summary JSON and the STL independently of score.py, under the user's decisions of 2026-09-24 (F3a boundary-only, F3d wired, BLC_beta exact). Re-frozen 2026-09-26 for the user's decision that feature-edge capture is a hard constraint on a body with sharp edges: every probe row carries its STL fingerprint's sharp_edge_length_m (30 deg) and plane_path (remedies.on_plane on its config), and every expect carries F3e and feature_capture, computed from the summary's snap stage (n_feature_edges, n_snapped_to_edge, n_snapped_to_corner) and its config's feature_tolerance; cubep_nofeat, cubep_nofeat_cf, cubep_nosnap flip to fail. Re-frozen 2026-09-27 for the capture signal (92.62): the 13 sharp probes whose attraction reached an edge were re-run with the mesh tree's release binary (sha256 7ff16117..., output-only since 054bba67 by L1b's replay), every mesh number equal; the re-run's stages[snap].feature_capture is spliced into their frozen summary.json and nothing else in it changes; their expect carries feature_capture = captured_length_m / sharp_length_m and F3e false (every share is above 0). Re-frozen 2026-10-02 for D-L5 (F3e is a chain-form capture share below gates.json feature_capture_min 0.5): the 13 measured probes were re-run with the L0c binary (sha256 72f7851e..., (92.62) along chains, output-only against 7ff16117 by lreplay's 97 rows); every mesh number equal, the chain-form stages[snap].feature_capture replaces the per-segment one in their summary.json and nothing else changes; their expect carries the chain-form share and F3e = share < 0.5.
